# Combine abundance information Pull together data from all life stages. There are a couple of graphs in here; life stages are not in order and I did not try to make them look nice, but they will give a very rough idea of what's in the data. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(tidyverse) library(plotly) source(here::here("functions.R")) in_path <- here::here("data", "processed", "byLifeStage") in_env <- here::here("data", "processed", "environmental") out_path <- here::here("data", "processed") ``` ::: The files for each life stage have the same columns in them. Some have additional columns that are removed at this stage. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} in_files <- paste0( c("postlarval", "juvenile", "subadult", "adult", "adult.landings.brown", "adult.landings.white"), "_byShrimpYear.csv") in_paths <- file.path(in_path, in_files) ``` ::: I will create a few files: one with all abundance information for both species, so future data users can compare whichever subsets they are interested in. That will be in a subfolder `data/processed/combinedLifeStages`. Then I will split brown and white shrimp, and combine the environmental data with abundance data. These will be saved in `data/processed`. Landings data are retained in these files. Trip Ticket data has not been incorporated. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} dat <- in_paths |> purrr::map(read.csv) |> dplyr::bind_rows() |> select(all_of(sel_order_annual), abundanceIndex_fullTimePeriod, abundanceIndex_commonTimePeriod) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} write.csv(dat, here::here(out_path, "combinedLifeStages", "allAbundanceIndices.csv"), row.names = FALSE, na = "") ``` ::: ## Brown Shrimp ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} brn <- dat |> filter(species == "brown") p <- ggplot(brn, aes(x = shrimp_year, y = abundanceIndex_fullTimePeriod, col = life_stage)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, col = "gray40") + geom_line(linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.4) + geom_point() + theme_bw() + labs(title = "Brown Shrimp", x = "Shrimp Year", y = "Abundance Index", col = "Life Stage") + theme(legend.position = "bottom") plotly_out(p) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} brn_env <- read.csv(here::here(in_env, "brn_environmental.csv")) ``` ::: ## White Shrimp ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} wht <- dat |> filter(species == "white") p <- ggplot(wht, aes(x = shrimp_year, y = abundanceIndex_fullTimePeriod, col = life_stage)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, col = "gray40") + geom_line(linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.4) + geom_point() + theme_bw() + labs(title = "White Shrimp", x = "Shrimp Year", y = "Abundance Index", col = "Life Stage") + theme(legend.position = "bottom") plotly_out(p) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} wht_env <- read.csv(here::here(in_env, "wht_environmental.csv")) ``` ::: ## About **Input `.qmd` file** for this section was: **combine_processed_abundances.qmd** and can be found in the main directory. **Input data file(s)** - in `data/processed/byLifeStage`: - `postlarval_byShrimpYear.csv` - `juvenile_byShrimpYear.csv` - `subadult_byShrimpYear.csv` - `adult_byShrimpYear.csv` - `adult.landings.brown_byShrimpYear.csv` - `adult.landings.white_byShrimpYear.csv` **Modifications to data:** **Generated data file(s):** **Other notes about data:** - none
